blocks.title: Abstract
blocks.content:
The E8 root lattice can be constructed from the modular curve X(13) by
the invariant theory for the simple group PSL(2, 13). This gives a diﬀerent
construction of the E8 root lattice. It also gives an explicit construction of
the modular curve X(13).
